title: Preparing a lift-controls workshop
titleZh: 升降設備操作面板工作坊的安排
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Workshop coordinator guide
This workshop covers the factory’s lift controls. Choose the workshop room from the activity, not the headcount. A group that takes turns at a live control panel must use Room E with its instructor station. Room H is for discussion and paper exercises only. An on-screen view of a control panel is a paper exercise for booking purposes if nobody can send commands.

A participant who has already completed the control-panel check may attend an explanation by video. A participant whose check is still outstanding must take the live turn in person. A coach may observe remotely, but may not be counted as the instructor at Room E.

DOCUMENT 2 — Training records, Thursday
Name | Panel check | Availability on Friday
Ira | outstanding | on site 10:00–11:00
Bea | complete | video only after 10:15
Milo | complete | on site after 11:00
Jules | qualified instructor | on site 10:00–10:20
Dev | qualified instructor | video before noon

DOCUMENT 3 — Email from the organizer
We need a ten-minute live turn for Ira and a separate ten-minute review of the language on the checklist with Bea. The live turn must finish before the review begins. We don’t need Milo for either task. The review will show a recording of the panel on screen. It will not let anyone send a command.

Dev asked whether he can join the live turn just to observe. I also have a paper copy of the checklist with notes in the margin. Please share the clean page with Bea; the notes identify people from a previous class.
passageZh:
文件一｜工作坊協調指南
本工作坊涵蓋工廠升降設備的控制裝置。請依活動內容選工作坊教室，不要按人數選。要輪流操作實體控制面板的組別，必須使用設有講師站的 E 室。H 室只供討論與紙本練習。如果沒有人能透過螢幕送出控制指令，螢幕上顯示的控制面板畫面在預約時也按紙本練習處理。

已通過控制面板操作檢查的人，可透過視訊參加解說。尚未完成檢查的人，必須親自輪到時完成實機操作。教練可遠端觀摩，但不能計為 E 室現場的講師。

文件二｜星期四訓練紀錄
姓名｜面板操作檢查｜星期五可參加時間
艾拉｜未完成｜10:00–11:00 在現場
貝雅｜已完成｜10:15 之後僅能視訊
米洛｜已完成｜11:00 之後在現場
朱爾斯｜合格講師｜10:00–10:20 在現場
戴夫｜合格講師｜中午前可透過視訊

文件三｜主辦人郵件
艾拉需要十分鐘的實機操作，另外要與貝雅花十分鐘檢視檢查表用詞。實機操作須在檢視開始前完成。這兩件事都不需要米洛參與。檢視時會在螢幕上播放面板的錄影，不讓任何人送出指令。

戴夫問能否加入實機環節，只做觀摩。另外，我有一份紙本檢查表，邊欄附有備註。請與貝雅分享沒有備註的頁面；從備註能辨認上一次上課的人。
